annotation.title_clean: Statement on artificial intelligence, robotics and 'autonomous' systems
annotation.title_en: Statement on artificial intelligence, robotics and 'autonomous' systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Group on Ethics in Science and New Technologies (European Commission)
annotation.summary_en: EU Publications Office catalogue page for the European Group on Ethics' 2018 statement on AI, robotics and 'autonomous' systems. It calls for a process towards a common, internationally recognised ethical and legal framework and proposes fundamental ethical principles grounded in the EU Treaties and Charter of Fundamental Rights.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for a collective, inclusive process of reflection on AI, robotics and autonomous systems
Proposes an internationally recognised ethical and legal framework for design, production, use and governance
Sets out fundamental ethical principles based on EU Treaties and Charter of Fundamental Rights
Notes current efforts are a patchwork of disparate initiatives
